d:
Hello fellow internet denizens!
It's my first time ever translating/cleaning a manga.
I used AI for the translation but I made sure to cross reference with multiple sources to get a better idea of the story.
It's not perfect but I tried to make it readable.
Also. I don't know why but I decided to clean and translate all the japanese sound effects.
Man... it's a rabbit hole I was not prepared for!
If I ever do the other chapters, I'm not translating those ever again!
Anyway, peace out.
